newsitem.title: GERMANY: German 1995/96 sugar sales higher at 2.83 mln T.
newsitem.headline: German 1995/96 sugar sales higher at 2.83 mln T.

text.p: German domestic sugar sales in the 1995/96 (October/September) season were 2.83 million tonnes, up from 2.76 million in Oct/Sept 1994/95, data from the sugar industry association WVZ showed.
Domestic sugar output in 95/96 totalled 3.83 million tonnes compared with 3.67 million a year earlier.
The figures were rounded, whites value.
Sugar sales in September alone of 278,110 compared with 236,698 in August 1996 and 236,582 in September 1995.
Stocks at the end of September totalled 239,562 tonnes versus 250,854 a year earlier.
Carry-in stocks on October 1, 1995 had been 250,854 tonnes (versus 470,689 a year earlier).
September imports of 35,527 tonnes were up from 17,397 a year earlier and exports of 52,327 tonnes compared with 42,867 in September 1995.
September sugar output of 3,972 tonnes was up from 1,834 a year earlier.
